title: An immune-related gene signature predicts the 28-day mortality in patients with sepsis.

models.verbatim_formula: risk score = sum_{i=1..n} beta_i * i (beta = multivariate Cox coefficient; i = gene expression); coefficients HLA-DMB -0.685, IL4R -0.668, LTB4R -0.298
models.expression_scale_used: GEO series matrix values, probes collapsed to gene symbol by averaging; no further transformation stated
models.cutoff: median risk score of each dataset
models.reported_performance: 28-day mortality AUC: GSE65682 training (n=240) 0.704; testing (n=239) 0.601; entire GSE65682 (n=479) 0.648; E-MTAB-4451 (n=106) 0.619; C-index in training 0.696
models.source_location: Methods 'Construction and validation of prognostic IRG signature' + Table 2 + Figures 2-4

notes: Random 1:1 split of GSE65682 (479 sepsis with 28-day follow-up). DEGs and WGCNA used GSE65682 sepsis vs 42 healthy controls. Paper states GSE65682 platform as GPL570 (GEO lists GPL13667) - recorded as stated. Coefficients are multivariate Cox (after LASSO); LTB4R P=0.135 in final model.
